notes.title: Dirty Jobs Simulator needs YOU for some awful work!
notes.content:
Are you just a guy who wants to earn some easy cash? Well, this ain’t the work you’re looking for - here you’ll get a rollercoaster of a lifetime to earn your living!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35402537/683675be07b2b85a75daf6f66dbb7b6cd391eeba.png[/img]
Find yourself going through sewers to pick up the trash - this will help you hate people who dump it there even more…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35402537/11292e8e30b612f312c1863a04facd75fb467ea9.jpg[/img]
...or maybe you fancy a nice dinner? With you as the main course, running from dangerous creatures while trying to get rid of all that sh…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35402537/c5ca52e7f6c8d12335370aacf722136b60761c9f.jpg[/img]
...it is what it is, and all work must be done - even when you’re seeing red, there’s blood everywhere and these pigs are starting to look as if they have it better than you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35402537/ebda953a0b62c9063f2509ff84ef340717dd324b.jpg[/img]
Does this place look like your street outside? See all that trash? Why can’t people even clean after themselves? This is dirty - even dirtier than the work you do!
